entries.title: Breaking the ice: Scientists use attracting particles to form an anti-spin ice
entries.summary: In a recent Nature Communications study, researchers have reported the realization of an anti-spin ice, a system that does the opposite of conventional spin ices by breaking the ice rule that governs them.
